abilities._comment: Choose 1 or both; * Target dagger attack gets +3{p}. * Target card defending an attack with stealth gets -3{d} this turn. Was a single unconditional +3. MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE reads a target in its OWN params; with none it shifts combat.total_defense -- the whole block -- where 'TARGET card defending' is one card. The stealth test is about the ATTACK so it stays a condition on the mode; the target picks WHICH defending card. It also authored amount -3 with no mod, and mod defaults to ADD: the same number either way here, but the pair only agreed by accident. Same defect as shred_yellow.
